source_refs.note: Topic 2.5.1.4 Keyword Arguments (PDF 47, printed 44). The printed string lacks spaces ('and I am' joins); the lesson adds them.

blocks.text: You can call functions using keyword arguments, which makes the code more readable.
Example: Define a function with keyword arguments.

book_errors: return "My name is  " + name + "and I am" + str(age) + “years old."

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: As printed the program does not run: return is not indented, and “years old." and “Ali" open with a curly quote (SyntaxError). Even with these fixed, the strings lack spaces, so it prints My name is  Aliand I am20years old. The return line should be: return "My name is " + name + " and I am " + str(age) + " years old."
Explanation: In this example, the introduce function is called using keyword arguments, specifying age first and then name.
